answer: For a poll on a hollow basalt beacon, rostered keys first submit signed commitments to choices. After commitments close, the server randomly selects 10 keys from the roster. It checks their election-bound signatures and reveals against their commitments, counting one matching reveal per selected key and rejecting invalid or missing reveals. Gaining a higher selection chance may require recruiting more keyholders, costing effort. Shared keys enable abuse, and non-revealers lose representation.
